g.text: RED-DEN-BOER-FIXED-CDH\nden Boer DLP-to-Fixed-CDH reduction\ngroup cost = O(sqrt(l) log(r)^2/log(l)); oracle queries = O(log(r)log log(r))

g.text: THM-CG-SOLVING-DEGREE\nCaminata-Gorla: sd = max(last fall, max GB degree)\nsd_sigma(F) = max{d_lastfall(F), maxGBdeg_sigma(F)}

g.title: LB-SHOUP-DLP
g.text: LB-SHOUP-DLP\nShoup generic DLP lower bound\nsuccess = O(m^2/p); constant success => m = Omega(sqrt(p))

g.text: LB-CGK-ADVICE\nGeneric preprocessing advice tradeoff\nS T^2 = soft-Omega(epsilon N)

g.text: LB-CGK-PREPROCESS-TIME\nGeneric preprocessing-time tradeoff\nP T + T^2 = Omega(epsilon N)

g.text: BRIDGE-GENERIC-TABLE\nConditional generic simulation of table decomposition

g.title: ATTACK-GHS-WEIL-DESCENT
g.text: ATTACK-GHS-WEIL-DESCENT\nGHS Weil-descent attack\nT = O(q^(2+epsilon)) for fixed n

g.title: THEOREM-SUPERSINGULAR-SMALL-K
g.text: THEOREM-SUPERSINGULAR-SMALL-K\nSupersingular embedding-degree ceiling\nk=2 over F_p (p>=5); k<=6 in general

g.title: FACT-GROEBNER-COST-DEPENDENCE
g.text: FACT-GROEBNER-COST-DEPENDENCE\nGroebner cost depends on solving geometry\nFGLM=O(n D^3); F4/F5 matrix cost depends on d_reg/d_solve

g.title: ALG-GAUDRY-FIXED-EXTENSION
g.text: ALG-GAUDRY-FIXED-EXTENSION\nGaudry fixed-extension index calculus\nT=soft-O(q^(2-2/n)) for fixed n

g.title: OBSTRUCTION-XEDNI-HEIGHT
g.text: OBSTRUCTION-XEDNI-HEIGHT\nCanonical-height obstruction to xedni\none-shot Pr[success] <= C0/p (conditional); history-uniform hazard <= C0/p => E[T]=Omega(p)

g.title: THEOREM-XEDNI-FINITE-CORE
g.text: THEOREM-XEDNI-FINITE-CORE\nKernel-checked finite xedni core\nPr[fixed useful relation]=(q-1)/q^2; uniform hazard O(1/p) => E[T]=Omega(p)

g.title: FACT-S3-ROOTS-ARE-GROUP-LAW
g.text: FACT-S3-ROOTS-ARE-GROUP-LAW\nS3 rootfinding collapses to group subtraction\nS3(x_R,x_F,X)=(x_R-x_F)^2 (X-x(R-F))(X-x(R+F))

g.text: FACT-FIELD-DLP-AFTER-PAIRING\nTarget finite-field DLP governs pairing attack

g.text: ESTIMATE-QUANTUM-IONQ-2026\n2026 trapped-ion secp256k1 preprint estimate\n~1450 logical qubits; 40e6 Toffoli; 19397 physical qubits; 25.7 d; estimated success 63%

g.text: ALG-COPPERSMITH-LOW-HAMMING\nCoppersmith low-weight meet-in-the-middle\nE[T] = O(sqrt(w) * binom(n/2,w/2)); S = O(binom(n/2,w/2))

g.text: THEOREM-RHO-THREE-PARTITION\nRigorous three-partition rho bound\nT = O_epsilon(sqrt(r) log(r)^3)

g.text: ALG-STATIC-DH-AUXILIARY-POWERS\nStatic-DH auxiliary-power attack\nT = O((sqrt((r-1)/d)+sqrt(d))log(r)); Q = d
